guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Michael Weikath is well known for playing Gibson Flying V guitars throughout Helloween's career.
guitar.notes: Reasonably documented within power metal/guitar enthusiast circles.

tone.target: bright 80s power metal crunch with slick lead sustain
tone.profile: bright 80s power metal crunch with slick lead sustain
tone.summary: A high-gain chain utilizing a Boost for attack, Distortion for crunch, an AC30 TB amp model, and a UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve bright, tight power metal tones suitable for both rhythmic chugging and sustained leads.

rig.name: Helloween - I Want Out - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and improve overall signal clarity.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for high-gain metal tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide articulate pick attack and tighten the low end for palm-muting (TS Boost emulation).
blocks.gap: None. Essential for achieving tight, punchy rhythm playing.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative if a dedicated boost is unavailable.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary high-gain crunch and saturation for power metal tones.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is a general choice, but specific Plexi/Marshall models would be ideal. This setting aims for aggressive mids without excessive scoop.

alternatives.reason: Could provide a similar mid-focused aggression.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the bright, articulate sound of a Marshall Plexi/AC30 stack.
blocks.gap: None. Perfect for classic rock and bright metal tones.

alternatives.reason: A strong alternative if the AC30 tone is too scooped.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end punch.
blocks.gap: None. Standard choice for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright upper mids and high frequencies for maximum articulation and 'bite'.
blocks.gap: None. Used to sculpt the tone after the main gain stages.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and dimension to sustained lead lines without muddying the crunch.
blocks.gap: Optional. Only use if leads sound too dry; otherwise, keep it off.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to better capture the specific high-end bite and mid-range punch required for 80s power metal leads.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper mids and high-end bite for articulate lead sustain.
